description: Create ONE MP3 that follows a subtitle timeline: every cue starts at its timestamp and speech speed auto-fits the cue duration. Use for video voiceover, dubbing translated subtitles, YouTube localization, tutorials and any edit where audio must line up with existing video. Pass either raw `srt` (SRT or WebVTT text) or `segments` with start_ms/end_ms. For several speakers set `speaker_voices` and prefix cue text with '[Name]' or 'Name:'. The resulting MP3 starts at 00:00 of the video, so it can be muxed directly with ffmpeg (commands are returned). Consumes credits.

max_speech_rate.description: Highest auto-fit speed when a cue is too short for its text.

min_speech_rate.description: Lowest auto-fit speed. Set min = max for a fixed speed.

voice.description: Optional per-segment voice token; defaults to `voice`.

speaker_voices.description: Map speaker name -> voice token, e.g. {"Host": "v1:...", "Guest": "v1:..."}.

voice.description: Default voice token for cues without a speaker/voice.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds the server waits for the audio before returning. If the job is still PENDING, call get_job_status later with the returned job_id.

name: srt_to_speech
title: Subtitles to speech (video voiceover / dubbing)
